newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Lippo Cikarang to offer 108.59 million shares.
newsitem.headline: Lippo Cikarang to offer 108.59 million shares.

text.p: Indonesian property firm PT Lippo Cikarang, a member of the Lippo Group, said on Thursday it planned to offer 108,588,000 new shares, or a 15.60 percent stake in its enlarged share capital, to the public later this month.
Lippo Cikarang said in a statement the share offering period was expected to be between June 25 to June 27 while the listing date was expected to be on July 26.
Cikarang expected to raise around 100 billion rupiah from the share offering.
The total number of shares after the initial public offering would reach 696 million shares, it said.
